title: Lost Communication With Remote Start Module
plain: Other computers in the car have stopped hearing from the remote start module. It runs a comfort or convenience feature.
symptoms: The feature that module controls may not work
Other modules may set related codes

causes.name: The remote start module lost power or ground (blown fuse or bad ground)
Damaged, corroded or loose network wiring or connector
Weak battery or low system voltage
Failed remote start module
Another module shorting out the network

checks: Test the battery and charging voltage first
Check the fuses, power and ground for the remote start module
See which modules answer a scan tool to narrow down the break
Inspect network wiring and connectors near the module
fix: Restore power, ground or wiring to the remote start module; replace the module only after those test good.

title: Internal Control Module Software Incompatibility
plain: A control module found that its own software does not match its setup or the rest of the vehicle. This usually happens after a module was replaced or reprogrammed.
symptoms: Check engine or other warning light on
Feature run by that module may not work

causes.name: Module replaced with a used or wrong part number
Module not programmed, or programmed with the wrong software
Software update interrupted, for example by low battery voltage
Other modules need updating to match

checks: Ask whether any module was recently replaced or reprogrammed
Check the module part number and software level against the maker data
Keep a battery maintainer connected during any reprogramming
fix: Program the module with the correct software using dealer-level tools.
